description: Header file defining the PackagerImplementation class for managing package operations, including configuration, installation, synchronization, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: PackagerImplementation

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Nested class for JSON configuration parameters related to package management.

classes.name: InstallationData

classes.description: Worker thread class for handling package installation asynchronously.
